Perks › Epic

Clean Finish

Epic perk · Hand award

Going domino doubles the opposing hand award.

In-game card text

How it works

When you go domino (play your last bone), the award you collect from Rival's remaining bones is doubled for each copy: two copies make it four times as large.

  • It only works when you go domino, not when you win a blocked hand.
  • The doubled award is rounded up to a multiple of five.
